title: Fake parcel delivery
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Text message says a parcel could not be delivered because the address is incomplete. The victim opens a link, updates the address and pays a small redelivery fee on a fake courier page that steals the card number.
description_zh: 短訊話包裹派送失敗，地址不完整，要撳連結更新地址，再付少量重新派送費用。假速遞網站會盜取信用卡資料。

title: Fake bank alert
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Message pretends to come from a bank and says the account is suspended or has an unusual login. The link opens a fake online banking page that collects the password and one-time password.
description_zh: 訊息扮銀行，話戶口被凍結或者有異常登入，連結去假網上銀行，騙取密碼同一次性驗證碼。

title: Fake officials phone call
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Caller claims to be immigration, police or mainland public security officers. The victim is accused of money laundering or smuggling, told to keep the investigation secret and to transfer savings to a supervised safe account.
description_zh: 來電者自稱入境處、警察或者內地公安，指事主涉嫌洗黑錢或者走私，要求保密，再將積蓄轉去安全監管戶口。

title: Investment scam
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: A mentor in a messaging group promises guaranteed high returns from crypto or stock tips. The victim deposits money on a fake trading platform and cannot withdraw it.
description_zh: 投資導師喺群組承諾保證高回報，推介虛擬貨幣或者股票貼士。事主入錢去假交易平台後無法提款。

title: Job and task scam
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Part-time job offers easy daily income for liking videos or completing online tasks. Small commissions are paid at first, then the victim must top up larger amounts to unlock earnings.
description_zh: 兼職聲稱日賺高薪，只需要讚好影片或者完成網上任務。初時有小額佣金，之後要求事主入大額先可以提款。

title: Family impersonation
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Someone says they are a son, daughter or friend with a new phone number and asks for an urgent loan or payment because of an emergency.
description_zh: 有人自稱仔女或者朋友，話換咗新電話號碼，因為急事要借錢或者代付款項。

title: Prize and refund lure
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Message announces a lucky draw prize, tax refund or subsidy. To claim it the victim must fill in card details or pay a handling fee first.
description_zh: 訊息話你中獎、退稅或者可以領取津貼，要先填信用卡資料或者繳交手續費先領取到。

title: Remote access scam
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Fake support staff persuade the victim to install a remote control app or an APK file, then take over the phone and banking apps.
description_zh: 假客服叫事主安裝遙距控制程式或者 APK，然後控制部電話同銀行 app。

title: Online shopping scam
source: PLACEHOLDER: P1 to add ADCC reference
description_en: Seller on social media offers a heavily discounted item and asks for payment by FPS, then disappears without shipping the goods.
description_zh: 社交平台賣家以超低價賣貨，要求用轉數快付款，收錢後就消失，冇寄貨。
